title: 75 with a dial
subtitle: A printed 75-key case with a dial and a column of keys beside it
role: Design, drawings for making, and the build
summary: A white printed case for 75 keys, with a row of function keys, a separate column on the right and a dial. Its parts are spread over five Fusion files, which fit together because they were drawn at the same coordinates.

sections.heading: Five files, one keyboard
sections.body: The outer case, base, top frame, plate and side strips were drawn in separate files between January and March 2022. They share one set of coordinates, so the parts drop into place when the files are opened together.

sections.heading: How it goes together
sections.body: The outer case is open underneath and the base closes it. The top frame sits in a step at the top of the case. At the front edge the plate sits between the case and the base with 0.5 mm above it and 3 mm below.

sections.heading: Built
sections.body: The case was printed in white, built and used. The build differs from the files in small ways, from finishing and fitting by hand.

sections.heading: In other colours
sections.body: The same case rendered in four other finishes. These are studies, not builds.
